0.headline: Five drafts, zero points, one hundred fourteen up for grabs
0.overview: Pre-season, and the scoreboard is a beautiful blank slate: five drafts, zero points apiece, every castaway still breathing, and 114 on the table for all of them. Tami, drafting first in the snake, opened with Jelly at #1 and stacked five bodies including the leftover Sharonda at #21, though only her best four count. Taylor grabbed Kristin at #2, Kylie took Aaliyah at #3, Tim scooped Lewis at #4, and Austin, picking last, doubled up immediately with Linnea and Jenna at #5 and #6. Different shapes, identical starting line. Let's see whose blueprint holds.

lines.text: Austin sat at the back of the snake and cashed in with back-to-back picks Linnea and Jenna, then closed with Carter and Eric for a 4-of-4 roster nobody can call thin.

Kylie's "Chef, Counsel & Chaos" runs Aaliyah at #3, Cristian, Alexis and Kilby — a chef, an HR head, a defense attorney and a game designer, which sounds less like a tribe and more like a hostage negotiation.
Tami used the first overall pick on Jelly and then quietly hoarded five castaways through Rob at #20 and Sharonda at #21, knowing only her best four will ever count.
Taylor went crisis management at #2 with Kristin, 49, then layered in Ori, Ana and Brady the pro wrestler — chokeslams and voice acting, all still in.
Tim took Lewis at #4 and Maggie at #7 — two farmers, no apologies — then balanced the barn with Devin and Thien An.

awards.label: Boldest draft
awards.text: Tami is carrying five castaways when only four score, betting that depth beats precision.

awards.label: Safest draft
awards.text: Tim built "Two Farmers and a Bus" on Lewis, Maggie, Devin and Thien An — no gimmicks, all four still in.

1.headline: Four drafts unscathed, one already bleeding after night one
1.overview: One episode in and the scoreboard is basically a four-way tie at the top: Austin, Tami, Taylor and Tim all banked 4 points and all still have every castaway breathing, each with 110 on the table. Austin and Tim share the best draft GPA at 3.75, Tami sits at 3.6 with a fifth body in Sharonda thanks to that leftover pick #21, and Taylor's 3.5 rides on Savu muscle. Then there's Kylie — 3 points, 3 of 4 still in, 85 on the table, GPA 3, and the First Blood badge nobody wants. Savu's immunity win protected a lot of rosters. Kylie's didn't get the memo.

lines.text: Austin's "Livestock and Lenses" is flawless so far — 4 of 4 in, a 3.75 GPA, and Eric at #16 already grading out as the number one steal on his board.

Tami's "Advanced Degrees Alliance" is the deepest thing on the board with 5 of 5 alive and Sharonda, the leftover pick #21, immediately looking like a rank 1 steal — only her best four count, and that's a luxury nobody else has.
Taylor's "Crisis, Chaos and Chokeslams" is tied at 4 points with a 3.5 GPA, and Brady at #19 is already the steal that makes this roster louder than its draft position.
Tim's "Toka Farmhands & Friends" matches Austin's 3.75 GPA with all four in, and Thien An at #17 turning into a rank 1 steal means the farm is running clean.

Kylie, "Chaos & Counsel" took the first hit of Survivor 51 — Aaliyah, a #3 pick now grading as a rank 21 reach, went out first, dropping Kylie to 3 points, 3 of 4, and only 85 on the table, though Kilby at #18 as a rank 1 steal is a real consolation.

awards.label: Draft of the week
awards.text: Five castaways, five survivors, and a leftover #21 pick in Sharonda already rated the top steal — Tami turned the scraps into insurance.

awards.label: Ouch of the week
awards.text: First Blood is a badge, but losing your #3 pick Aaliyah in episode one and watching 25 points leave the table is a rough way to earn it.
